name: slopTV
author: Eugene Ray / Senior Engineer
description: Keyboard-driven player for the Slop Cannon feed: X's official embedded player in a Chromium app window (Rust controller); built once into ~/.cache. Keybind plus a bar icon.

barWidget.description: Bar icon that starts, focuses or closes slopTV (also Super+Shift+Ctrl+T).

schema.label: Show bar icon (keybind works either way)
